note: Connector matrix and credential plan (Step 01, docs/06). Every source starts access_pending and becomes live only after a real credential is configured and the demonstration below has been run and recorded in PROGRESS.md. expected_capabilities are what we plan to use, not demonstrated facts: true = expected, false = not used, null = unknown until demonstrated. demo_requirement values answer I04 and were accepted by the product owner on 2026-09-25.
credential_location: .env at the repository root for local runs (never committed); GitHub Actions secrets for CI. Only variable names are recorded here.

model_providers.purpose: All LLM calls (D07); model roles per D10
model_providers.demonstration: make smoke-model (python -m app.cli smoke-model) confirms the configured model IDs and makes one real structured-output call; returned model ID and request ID recorded in PROGRESS.md (Step 03)

connectors.yields: URL, title, snippet and date if shown. Discovery metadata only, never evidence.
connectors.deletion_method: Not applicable: only discovery metadata is stored, and it expires with the run record
connectors.demonstration: A real query for one of the five projects returns results; query, result count, request time and response ID recorded in PROGRESS.md

connectors.yields: Full page text with title, dates and author role where visible
connectors.cursor_method: URL queue from discovery; per-URL content hash
connectors.deletion_method: Re-fetch returns 404/410 or a removal notice on two checks: confirmed deletion, stored payload erased
connectors.demonstration: Fetch one allow-listed public page found by Brave for a supplied project; robots.txt decision, content hash and extracted publication date (or unknown) recorded

connectors.provider: Static HTTP fetch with Trafilatura extraction (local)
connectors.yields: Main text, title, publication date (or unknown) and author name where the page states them, for allow-listed public pages
connectors.no_credential_reason: Runs locally; gated by the host's source-policy family (allow-list), robots.txt and an honest user agent instead of a key
connectors.cursor_method: URL queue from discovery; per-URL content hash
connectors.deletion_method: Re-fetch returns 404/410 on two checks: confirmed deletion, stored payload erased after invalidation
connectors.demonstration: Fetch one allow-listed public page found by Brave for a supplied project; robots.txt decision, content hash and extracted publication date (or unknown) recorded

connectors.yields: Rendered page text for allow-listed public pages
connectors.no_credential_reason: Runs locally; gated by the host allow-list and the web_public_pages policy instead of a key
connectors.cursor_method: URL queue from discovery; per-URL content hash
connectors.deletion_method: Re-fetch returns 404/410 or a removal notice on two checks: confirmed deletion, stored payload erased
connectors.demonstration: Render one allow-listed public page found by Brave for a supplied project; robots.txt decision, content hash and extracted publication date (or unknown) recorded

connectors.yields: Video/Short metadata and public comments. Titles and descriptions are not spoken-content evidence.
connectors.cursor_method: search query + publishedAfter window + pageToken; commentThreads pageToken
connectors.deletion_method: videos.list returns no item: mark removed, erase stored metadata and comments
connectors.demonstration: A real search for a supplied project returns a video; one commentThreads page fetched (or comments-disabled status recorded); quota units used recorded

connectors.yields: Registration details for the supplied RERA IDs: dated primary records for fact verification
connectors.no_credential_reason: Public website; gated by the robots.txt/terms review under the official_records policy
connectors.deletion_method: Re-fetch on refresh; keep the dated record reference and flag changes for review
connectors.demonstration: Fetch the public record for one supplied RERA ID with the robots/terms decision recorded

connectors.provider: Public captions (youtube-transcript-api), else public audio (yt-dlp) transcribed locally with faster-whisper (D33, D47)
connectors.yields: Timestamped spoken content from authorised media only
connectors.no_credential_reason: Public videos without sign-in (D33); no key. Needs network access to youtube.com (I17)
connectors.deletion_method: Withdrawal, confirmed deletion or expiry of the video erases its transcript windows and translations after invalidation (D45, D47)
connectors.demonstration: A real project video's captions or audio processed with original timing preserved (Step 06); a synthetic speech set alone does not count

connectors.deletion_method: Fetch by ID shows removed/deleted: erase stored payload
connectors.demonstration: Approved access confirmed in writing; a real search for a supplied project returns posts; analysis and derived-content permissions recorded

connectors.yields: Posts and replies within the entitled search window
connectors.deletion_method: Per entitlement terms; erase on deletion/compliance events
connectors.demonstration: Entitled tier confirmed; a real search for a supplied project; search window, pagination, quota and downstream permissions recorded

connectors.provider: Instagram public posts and reels through Scrapfly (discovery by Brave Search)
connectors.yields: Public post and reel captions with the author's username and post time. Comments are not read in this version.
connectors.cursor_method: Brave query restricted to instagram.com per project; each post read once (shortcode)
connectors.deletion_method: Re-read on refresh: a removed post (HTTP 404/410) is marked gone and its caption erased
connectors.demonstration: A real public post of one supplied project read through Scrapfly with the robots.txt verdict and the credits used recorded

connectors.yields: Only capabilities granted to an approved app
connectors.deletion_method: Per platform terms; erase on deletion events
connectors.demonstration: Each promised public/comment/Reels capability demonstrated with an approved app

connectors.provider: Google Alerts by RSS (the product owner's own alerts; free listening source)
connectors.yields: New mentions Google finds for each project's alert: page address, title and when Google found it. Discovery metadata only; allow-listed pages are then read by the web reader.
connectors.cursor_method: Each feed read per run; a page already stored is not read again
connectors.deletion_method: Not applicable to the metadata; pages read follow the web reader's re-checks
connectors.demonstration: A real alert feed for a supplied project read, with its robots.txt verdict and the mentions it named recorded

connectors.yields: Aggregated social posts from the platforms named in the contract
connectors.deletion_method: Per contract; erase on provider deletion feed
connectors.demonstration: Contract names covered platforms; a real query for a supplied project returns items with native IDs, dates and redistribution rights
